API_scope: The reference joint autograd.grad requests all shared/private parameter gradients and full stacked-bank cotangent together. Candidate/repeat each use one small-logit grad and four native VJPs. Snapshot/comparison/RNG/resource metadata work makes no native forward or parameter gradient API.
counter_semantics: Callbacks increment before calls; reference grad/map counters increment and save before their APIs. Candidate source counters are caller-owned and reconciled in finally even on exceptions. A hard external termination preserves last persisted counters as a lower bound, never a complete success bill.
